workflow client-thread, version 2

when a Slack message is posted in acme/slack, in conversation C0123
match text exists

flow
  events in acme as client-thread
  step thread: find the session that took this conversation, with claude-code
    emits found and not-found
    idle → give
    busy → queued
    none → route
    otherwise → tell
  step queued: wait for thread's session to be free, up to 2 hours
    free → give
    otherwise → tell
  step route: choose a project among acme-site and billing, by hints
    looking at text
    project acme-site, in /example/home/work/acme-site
    project billing, in /example/home/work/billing and /example/home/work/billing-api
    none → tell
  step find: find a session in route's project, with claude-code
    idle → give
    otherwise → tell
  step give: session client-prompt, version 2, with claude-code, to thread or find
    give
      fields text
      text "Do what they ask. Don't push."
    then → end
  step tell: tell me "A message in acme/slack needs you"

keep author.name, text
at most 60 an hour
